data.name: EveryThirtySecondsAndNote
data.value: Every thirty seconds, and at once after a poll brings in jobs, contracts or assets, each pending order in the Order Tracker is matched against what could fill it: a contract issued by one of your characters or personal corporations to that buyer after the order was placed completes it outright; otherwise unreserved stock on hand, or the soonest industry job producing the item, whose completion date becomes the order's estimated date. data.value: Collects player-structure IDs from assets, contracts, industry jobs, market orders and wallet entries, then resolves each one's name, type, owner and position.
